advisories.title: v4 is the first version in the chain where a verbatim-carry block's sourceSha256 no longer equals the LIVE COORD digest, so two different superseded COORD digests now sit beside the live one.
advisories.finding: d012DecidedPolicyCarriedVerbatim.sourceSha256 is b38bd900…, which was the live COORD digest at v2 and v3 but is not live at v4; recordedInputs.governingSources carries 673a7a43…, the v1-era digest. The live COORD is 94ccb208…. Through v3 the carry pin and the LIVE remeasurement pin agreed, so a reader could not be misdirected by reading the nearest digest; at v4 they diverge for the first time. A reader who resolves the carry block by its own stated digest is sent to bytes that are not at HEAD and must consult git history to verify a carry that in fact verifies at HEAD.
advisories.whyNotBlocking: The carried 73 lines are byte-identical to the live file at COORD lines 1061-1133, verified directly against 94ccb208 rather than against the pin, so nothing the carry asserts is stale in substance. The subject also pre-declares the discipline: recordedInputs carries standing NAMED-PROPERTIES-ONLY, its role text states the live digest is the remeasurement block whose standing is LIVE, and reviewGuidance instructs the reviewer to attack any governing COORD pin marked LIVE precisely because only the remeasurement block is. The divergence is a declared consequence of append-only COORD motion, and both /recordedInputs and /d012DecidedPolicyCarriedVerbatim are off the closed roster, so the author could not have refreshed them without breaking the roster discipline that this review otherwise confirms.
advisories.suggestion: In a future successor, either add the two carry-block digests to the roster so they can be refreshed alongside a new remeasurement, or give each carry block an explicit field distinguishing the digest at which the lines were measured from the digest at which they were last confirmed to still reproduce, so divergence is stated rather than inferred.

advisories.title: The two v3 advisories that D-123 records as traveling as honesty work are neither adopted nor acknowledged in v4, and the closed roster structurally prevented recording them.
advisories.finding: D-123 states that Claude advisories INIC-V3-CL-ADV-1 and INIC-V3-CL-ADV-2 travel as honesty work. v4 is v3's successor and does neither. ADV-1 asked that a demotion note distinguish a block whose digests still reproduce from one whose digests are superseded; v4's demoted reMeasurementAtV3 note reuses the same template unchanged. ADV-2 asked that honestyRepairsFromV2 be reworded to drop the presupposition carried by 'any other prior guidance element'; that field is untouched. appliesFindingsOf is byte-identical to v3 and, like honestyRepairsFromV2, is absent from basedOn.method's closed roster, so there was no rostered site at which the traveling advisories could have been recorded.
advisories.whyNotBlocking: Advisories are non-binding by construction and the verdict rule counts only blockers and SHOULD-FIX, so non-adoption creates no false statement and no scope effect. The substance of ADV-1 is in any case moot at v4: its complaint was that reMeasurementAtV3 rotated standing without measuring anything, whereas reMeasurementAtV4 is a genuine fresh measurement carrying a new COORD digest, a new head, and two new pins. notFoldedThisSuccessor being empty is also accurate on the finding-level reading, since both v3 reviews were ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX and there was nothing to fold.
advisories.suggestion: Add the traveling-advisory ledger to the roster in a future successor, so each successor records the advisories it inherits and states for each whether it adopts, defers, or considers it moot. That would let a reader see that ADV-1 was overtaken by events rather than silently dropped.

verdictRule: ACCEPT only when blockers=0 and shouldFix=0. Advisories do not block.

coordinatorSummary: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX, with 2 non-blocking advisories. I attacked v4 on fourteen fronts and none landed above advisory. The custody chain is intact: the subject held cd7ff948… at 0444 across the whole review, HEAD never moved off 40d9916, and all seven pinned digests reproduce. The two carries verify byte-exact, and I checked the D-012 carry against the LIVE COORD 94ccb208 rather than its own pin, which is where a stale carry would have shown; it did not. The closed-roster claim survives a recursive path diff — sixteen deltas, all rostered, with the three list growths confirmed as true appends, so the INIC-V2-S1 failure mode does not recur. The load-bearing change is the standing move from NAMED-NOT-AUTHORED to NAMED, and I refused to take corpus v1's word for it: all 17 catalogued fixture files exist and reproduce their digests, so the upgrade is earned fact rather than deference to a downstream artifact. reMeasurementAtV4 is a genuine fresh measurement, not the standing rotation v3 was criticised for. Both advisories concern bookkeeping the closed roster structurally prevented this successor from doing — two carry-block COORD pins that diverge from the live digest for the first time in the chain while still verifying against it, and the v3 traveling advisories having no rostered site to be recorded at. Neither creates a false statement or any scope effect. DR-104 stays DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED and unsatisfied; DR-103 is untouched; no D-096 (A) grant, no D-056 class opened, no implementation authorized.
